output: {"concerns":["CV headline claim 'Drove 45% ARR growth and doubled activation' at ShopStream conflicts with stated scope: built cohort dashboards, wrote experiment readouts, and coordinated two onboarding-copy tests, while 'PM and lifecycle lead owned roadmap and launch decisions'—impact is not clearly attributable to this candidate.","Role history is Product Analyst (ShopStream, 2022-present) and Marketing Analyst (Alto, 2020-2022); no titled Product Manager experience or evidence of owning growth roadmap, prioritization, or launch decisions.","Alto work is limited to lifecycle reporting and campaign QA—no product ownership or growth PM scope shown."],"recommendation":"clarify","verify":["Ask candidate to separate their specific contributions from the PM/lifecycle lead on the 45% ARR and doubled-activation outcomes, with metrics they personally influenced vs. squad-level results.","Confirm whether they ever owned roadmap, experiment prioritization, or launch decisions (vs. analysis and coordination only) on the ShopStream growth squad.","Probe for any IC or acting PM ownership of growth initiatives, success metrics, and stakeholder decision rights beyond dashboards, readouts, and coordinating two onboarding-copy tests."]}
